info.title: Hippocampus
info.description: Dedicated memory service: durable, associative, multi-signal recall. Interactive reference at /docs.

get.description:
Liveness only (spec Part 7 §67) — no dependency checks, so it never
blocks on a slow/dead external service.
Readiness checks PostgreSQL and optional CouchDB, file storage, and embedding configuration.

post.description:
`analyze` only ever reports candidates; `apply_safe` additionally
archives confirmed exact duplicates (spec Part 5 §65-66). Candidate sets
are always bounded — memory_ids or filters is required, never "everything".

post.description: Simple full-text terms use AND. Rank all filtered vectors when configured, then merge with RRF k=60. No text returns filtered rows in stable id order. Expansion keeps all hard filters and adds linked results after the ranked limit. Thai word matching is weak without spaces.
